# Data Dawgs

> A personal sandbox for decision-making across forecasting, fantasy football, betting
> markets and EPA. Tools are built to beat a market; receipts test whether they did.

Start with [`/data/index.json`](https://datadawgs216.com/data/index.json), the generated
manifest of every machine-readable file with its date, byte count and SHA-256. Every data
file is an envelope with `as_of`, `source`, `note`, `built`, `canonical_url` and `data`.
Cite `as_of` with every number.

[`/data/surfaces.json`](https://datadawgs216.com/data/surfaces.json) maps human pages to
machine surfaces and MCP tools. All 12 mapped surfaces have live machine access; 21
read-only MCP tools are live, including 8 deterministic Pound calculator tools.
`planned` means not callable. A per-user token comes from
`/connect.html`; the URL is the credential.

Confidence tiers: `labs` is useful but still being challenged; `dawg` survived validation;
`pound` is shelved with its reason attached. Do not present Labs output with Dawg confidence.

## The Pound

- [Workbench](https://datadawgs216.com/pound.html): model scoreboard and deterministic calculators.
- [Tool inventory](https://datadawgs216.com/data/pound-tools.json): status, delivery layers, blockers and minimum paths.
- [Contracts](https://datadawgs216.com/data/model-contracts.json): forecast fields, receipt rules and calculator I/O.
- [Provenance](https://datadawgs216.com/data/upstream-models.json): repositories, commits, dates, license status and integration mode.

The browser workbench converts odds, builds parlays, removes two-way vig, computes
declared-probability EV, sizes equal-payoff hedges, grades NFL passer rating, calculates a
538 Classic Elo one-game probability, translates probability to expected margin/cover,
grades Brier/log loss, and summarizes equal-weight belief statistics. Browser inputs stay local and
results are deterministic. Eight matching read-only MCP tools are live; caller-supplied calculator
inputs and results are not stored.

## Draft

- [Player pool + Market Value](https://datadawgs216.com/data/pool.json): 459 players; half-PPR, full-PPR and superflex auction values; `as_of 2026-07-29`. MV is market value, not projected points.
- [League](https://datadawgs216.com/data/league.json): 14 teams, $200, 15 spots, half PPR, no kicker, plus the public draft mirror.
- [2026 strategy](https://datadawgs216.com/data/strategy.md): positional curves and format playbooks, separating testable structure from analyst priors.

## Models and data

- [Team + QB EPA](https://datadawgs216.com/data/epa-teams.json): 2023–2025 nflverse play-by-play; descriptive, not predictive.
- [nfelo](https://datadawgs216.com/data/nfelo.json): ratings and backtest with the in-sample caveat.
- [Schedule + win probabilities](https://datadawgs216.com/data/survivor.json): 272 games; market-derived when a line existed, model-derived otherwise.
- [Parameters](https://datadawgs216.com/data/models.json): margin, Bozo and survivor assumptions and limitations.

## Receipts and method

- [Pre-registered forecasts](https://datadawgs216.com/data/receipts.json): 272 calls locked 2026-08-06, SHA-256 `4b87fe0e0790a1e6…`.
- [Receipt method](https://datadawgs216.com/data/receipts-method.md): hypotheses, grading and canonical hash reproduction.
- [Bozo rules](https://datadawgs216.com/data/bozo-rules.json) ([prose](https://datadawgs216.com/data/bozo-rules.md)): open weekly one-leg parlay game.
- [House reasoning rules](https://datadawgs216.com/data/method.md): base rates, ranges, falsifiers and selection-bias checks.
- [Toto philosophy](https://datadawgs216.com/data/toto-philosophy.md): reasoning conventions for the site AI.

## Agent notes

- `/data/` is public, static and CORS-open. No key or rate limit.
- If a dated number is stale enough to affect the answer, say so.
- `def_epa_play` is EPA allowed: lower is better.
- Simulation and modelled output are labelled; do not present either as observation.
- Nothing here is betting advice or certainty.
- Prefer `/data/` to the heavy, self-contained HTML pages.
